mechanics: 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate associated with Goku Black (Super Saiyan Rosé). The attack begins with a melee strike and, on connection, transitions into the Rosé Kamehameha beam. Current evidence distinguishes it from Super Black Kamehameha by its higher Ki cost and slower opening strike; community testing also documents that a successful opening strike makes the beam difficult to escape without an evasive. These behavioral observations are source-attributed rather than treated as universal frame data.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values and community-observed behavior are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
